elements.title: TechGirls Tour NASA Goddard
elements.content: Photo showing a woman speaking with a group of girls during a NASA Goddard tour; the background includes a Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope display. Printed caption: “TechGirls Tour NASA Goddard NASA Goddard hosted participants from the U.S. Department of State’s TechGirls program once again this summer. On Aug. 1, 2024, 133 girls from 37 different countries/territories toured Goddard’s research labs and TV production studios and heard from a panel of some of the incredible women that work at Goddard.” Photo credit: “NASA/Jay Friedlander”.

MANAGEMENT’S DISCUSSION AND ANALYSIS
TechGirls Tour NASA Goddard
NASA Goddard hosted participants from the U.S. Department of 
State’s TechGirls program once again this summer. On Aug. 1, 2024, 
133 girls from 37 different countries/territories toured Goddard's 
research labs and TV production studios and heard from a panel of 
some of the incredible women that work at Goddard.
PHOTO CREDIT 
NASA/Jay Friedlander
